effective_from: Only the round explicitly binding these bytes
rationale: Test one real Claude subscription essay and its visible provenance through one separate critique and one revision.
independent_critique: One fresh Claude critic session receives only this essay's archived draft, source evidence and a neutral rubric. This is general philosophical criticism, not a named-judge simulation.
revision: A fresh Claude author-role session receives this essay's archived draft, sources and critique. It is recorded as a new revision context, not the original author's resumed session.
archive_boundaries: Author stops after question and sources. Codex captures and checks the exact stage before releasing dependent work. New sources in any role require the same gate.
authorship: Claude chooses all philosophical content. Humans select process and model settings and relay neutral archive releases. Codex prepares, captures, verifies and indexes.
style: Clear natural English manuscript; concise Russian progress and report. No word minimum; at most 6000 words excluding bibliography.
model_policy: Use the model and effort selected by the operator in the subscription UI. Until observed, requested and observed values remain UNKNOWN; do not silently substitute a model.
budget: Exactly one standalone essay with one critique and one revision; manual subscription launch only. No worker, scheduler, paid API, purchase, publication or submission.
comparability: Separate from paused judges20. Different provider and one general critic; not a controlled model comparison or a permanent method ceiling. Fresh context is observable separation, not proof of independence.
